title: Figures 95-96: cylinder UAP pressure and temperature at 300 mph CFD plots
description: Two CFD contour plots for the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 300 mph with subsonic inlet and outlet. Figure 95 shows the pressure field (Pa) with a high-pressure region at the leading face; Figure 96 shows the temperature field (K) with an orange heated wake. BAASS cylinder shape aerodynamic analysis.
